items.claim: CORS candidates are harvested from collected endpoint data by running meg and filtering the results through gf cors, so CORS testing is driven from scan or proxy output rather than manual browsing.
items.body:
CORS candidates are harvested from collected endpoint data by running meg and filtering the results through gf cors, so CORS testing is driven from scan or proxy output rather than manual browsing.

HackTricks reference: cors (https://kathan19.gitbook.io/howtohunt/cors/cors.md)
items.disproof: gf cors returns no candidates from the collected data and manual review finds no endpoint reflecting an arbitrary Origin in access-control-allow-origin.
